intelligence.human_view:
Shawn said it, and here it is, in plain words, so it does not get forgotten.

Smart Meet needs to be done. Make sure this does not get forgotten.

Smart Meet is a way for people to video or chat with Naya. You need a video one-on-one or an audio one-on-one with her, but you can also do it in groups. Four or six on video, and up to ten on audio. That is the group shape: a small group on video, a bigger group on audio. And there should be the option for them to have more. We should have that available. For example, if they have a Smart Box, or a higher Pro count, we should consider having more. The higher you go, the more people you can bring into the call. That is the tier logic: the base gives you the group, the higher tiers give you the bigger group.

And then also, if they want to have an event on their page, we have that. We discussed that before. An event on your page is a thing you can host, and people can come to it, and you can sell it, and you can make money from it. What is involved in that? We should just get it done. The event is part of the same picture: you meet with Naya, you meet with your people, and you host events on your page, all in one place, all in NayaNET.

Smart Meet is Shawn's name, and it is locked. It is audio plus video sharing, and it is connected and available in Personal, Business, Space, Membership, and from a Smart Mail conversation. You can start a call from anywhere you are — from your personal page, from your business page, from your space, from your membership, or from a mail conversation. It is everywhere, because meeting is everywhere.

Paid members only. Free members do not get it. That is the line: Smart Meet is a paid-member feature. The free tier does not include calls. That is how the value works: the membership pays for the meeting.

Stage 1 at launch: video six plus audio ten. Six people on video, ten people on audio. That is the launch shape, and it is locked. Stage 2: bigger groups — fifty, one hundred, whatever people ask for — get enterprise-style plans, priced when the cost is known, never invented today. At launch, instead of automatic big-group pricing, there is a simple button: "Want more? Contact us for a quote." That is honest: we do not invent a price for something whose cost we do not know yet. We ask, we quote, we price it when we know it.

A call is not mail, and mail privacy still holds. No call content goes into mail. The call is the call, and the mail is the mail, and they do not leak into each other. Your calls are private, and your mail is private, and neither one becomes the other.

Calls are not built live in these areas today. That is the honest state: the design is locked, the pricing is recorded, but the calls are not built and not live. A call must be proven live — real people, real video plus audio, at those limits, phone first — before anyone is told calls work. That is the proof bar, and it is the same bar as everything else: prove it live, with real people, on a real phone, at the real limits, or do not say it works.

Events are Max-only, not Pro. That was decided, no question. The events package — host sellable events, plus monetization, plus your own event affiliates — is Max-only. The Max host keeps the full event profit. NayaNET takes no cut. The revenue from events is the per-live-head meter only. That is consistent with the lock: fifty percent on everything but events. The per-live-head rate is still open, and the final meter wording is still open. But the Max-only line and the full-profit line are locked.

The build is Nitro's lane, under the Design Gate. Nitro is the design head and the builder of the face. Power delivers the brief. This note is the brief. It says what Smart Meet is, what it is for, how it works, what features it carries, what real-world value it gives, and what problem it solves, so the team can build it in one shot. Get it done.
intelligence.child_view:
Imagine you can talk to Naya, not just by typing, but by seeing her and hearing her, like a video call with a friend. You can talk to her all by yourself, just the two of you, on video or just by voice. Or you can talk to her with your friends, in a group. Four or six of you can be on video together, and up to ten of you can be on audio together. And if you have a bigger membership, you can have even more people in the call. That is Smart Meet. It is a way to meet with Naya, and with your people, face to face and voice to voice, right inside NayaNET.

And imagine you can have a party on your page, an event, where lots of people come and you can even sell tickets to it, and you keep all the money from it. That is an event on your page. We talked about that before, and now we are going to build it.

But here is the important part: Smart Meet is not built yet. We have the plan, and we have the rules, but we have not built it. So we are going to build it now, and we are going to prove it works with real people, on a real phone, before we tell anyone it works. That is how we do things: we build it, we prove it, and then we say it is done.
